newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Lombard rate dives to 362.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Romania Lombard rate dives to 362.1 percent.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Friday the Lombard rate had fallen to 362.1 percent from an all-time high of 682.4 percent, following a drop in the average rate on one-week refinancing funds.
The Lombard rate, set weekly by multiplying the average auctioned rate by 1.6, is charged on overdraft credits.
The one-week rate dived to 226.31 percent on Thursday from 426.5 percent last week with the BNR refinancing offer undersubscribed as leu inflows emerged on a money market plagued by shoratges.
Operators said most inter-bank prices, which fell to some 300 percent from about 446 percent on Thursday, were poised for fresh lows following the fall in the BNR's key rates.
